summary: PASS: no regression. The round-3 candidate (manifest source_commit 40dbd24; reviewed at HEAD 4f312cc, same candidate ID) differs from the round-2 candidate in exactly one file, the test-only apps/web/e2e/journeys.spec.ts (manifest diff). The change makes the keyboard journey deterministic, keeps every assertion and adds a stricter one (Enter on the skip link focuses main#main). The BU hierarchy guard and migration 0009, destination authz, rate-limit keying, CI config and gate tooling are byte-identical to round 2. All assigned checks were run and passed: typecheck, build, lint, openapi, no-cdn, format, unit on Node 22 and 24 (326/326), integration twice on disposable PG16 (209/209, including bu-hierarchy-guard), gate/agent tests 105/105, deploy tests 59/59, install-sandbox 13/14 offline with the residual AC-1 effect (D-057), SBOM, DG0 historical validation, and ci.yml byte-identity (live CI is residual D-058). One new Low, non-mandatory finding, F-DG1-147: e2e specs are outside every typecheck target (pre-existing coverage gap; the current spec type-checks cleanly ad hoc). No unresolved Critical, High or mandatory finding.
